description.overloadgenerators.cpu_usage: Generates energy from CPU usage. Because thermal throttling is just free resistance.
description.overloadgenerators.memory_us: Generates energy from Memory usage. Less available memory means more power. (But you should apologize to the garbage collector)
description.overloadgenerators.tick_time: More lag, more power. Converts tick duration into energy.
description.overloadgenerators.optical_l: An extremely precise clock capable of detecting even the slightest variations in the flow of time.
description.overloadgenerators.server_cr: This generator absorbs the massive spacetime distortions and converts it into RF. The more chaotic the server, the more stable the power output.
